description: Pin to SHA: code actions + resolution engine for LSP, CLI update ref_style=sha support

tasks.title: Add resolved_sha to CheckResult + populate in check_action/check_action_remote
tasks.description: Add `resolved_sha: Option<String>` to CheckResult. Add resolve_current_sha() helper that looks up ref in version::Set (semver_tags, major_tags, default_branch). Populate in check_action (sync) and check_action_remote (async). Done when: field exists, populated for tags+default branch in sync path, all refs in async path, existing tests pass.

tasks.title: Add target_sha to DiagnosticData::Outdated + populate in status_to_diagnostic
tasks.description: Extend DiagnosticData::Outdated to carry target_sha: Option<String>. Populate from CheckResult's suggested target's SHA during status_to_diagnostic. Done when: DiagnosticData serializes/deserializes with target_sha, existing diagnostic tests pass.

tasks.title: Add ActionCheckEntry to DocumentState + populate during compute_diagnostics
tasks.description: Add ActionCheckEntry struct (ref_range, value_range, ref_str, resolved_sha) and store Vec<ActionCheckEntry> in DocumentState. Populate for ALL uses: refs during diagnostic computation. Done when: entries stored, accessible from code action handler.

tasks.title: Pin to SHA cursor-based code action (UpToDate + branch refs)
tasks.description: Implement cursor-based 'Pin to SHA' code action using ActionCheckEntry data. Fires for any non-SHA ref where cursor overlaps ref_range and resolved_sha is available. Uses CodeActionKind::REFACTOR. Done when: code action appears for up-to-date and branch refs, replaces ref with SHA.

tasks.title: Update & pin to SHA diagnostic-based code action (Outdated refs)
tasks.description: Add 'Update & pin to SHA (abcdef1...)' code action for Outdated diagnostics, using target_sha from DiagnosticData. Uses CodeActionKind::REFACTOR. Done when: action appears alongside existing update action for outdated refs.

tasks.title: Pin current to SHA diagnostic-based code action (Outdated refs)
tasks.description: Add 'Pin {current} to SHA' code action for Outdated diagnostics using resolved_sha from cursor-based entries. Uses CodeActionKind::REFACTOR. Done when: action lets user pin current outdated ref to its SHA without updating.

tasks.title: Config key [pin] comment = true + wire into code actions and CLI pin
tasks.description: Add [pin] section to config with comment bool (default true). When true, SHA edits append '# {ref}' comment. Wire into LSP code actions and CLI pin command. Done when: config parses, comment appended when enabled, omitted when disabled.

tasks.title: CLI update honors ref_style = sha
tasks.description: When ref_style = sha in config, CLI update emits SHA refs instead of tags. Reuses resolve_sha logic from pin command. Respects pin.comment config. Done when: actup update with ref_style=sha produces SHA refs with optional comments.

tasks.title: Tests: snapshot edits, code action generation, config interaction
tasks.description: Snapshot tests for: SHA resolution in check_action, code action generation (all 3 types), comment insertion, config interaction. Done when: tests cover happy paths and edge cases, no network calls.
